story_text: As a user, I want the system to reject a new password shorter than 8 characters during reset so that security standards are maintained.

positive.title: Prevent password reset submission with password shorter than 8 characters
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters.
positive.expected_result: The system should reject the password reset attempt and display an appropriate error message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

positive.title: Remove error message after entering valid password length during reset
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters.
4. Enter a new password that is at least 8 characters long and attempt to reset the password again.
positive.expected_result: The system should display a success message indicating that the password has been reset successfully.

positive.title: Allow successful login after resetting password with valid length
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to reset the password with a new password that is at least 8 characters long.
3. Attempt to log in with the new password.
positive.expected_result: The system should allow the user to log in with the new password.

negative.title: Backend accepts short password via API despite frontend validation
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters via API call.
negative.expected_result: The system should reject the password reset attempt and display an appropriate error message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

negative.title: System does not display an error message when a short password is entered during reset
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters.
negative.expected_result: The system should display an appropriate error message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

edge.title: Test that the system correctly handles attempts to reset the password with invalid input (e.g., empty password, only spaces)
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with an empty string or a string of only spaces.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an appropriate error message indicating that the password is invalid.

edge.title: Reset password with rapid repeated submissions of short passwords
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters multiple times in quick succession.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an appropriate error message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.

edge.title: Reset password with short password under slow network conditions
steps: 1. Request a password reset to receive a token.
2. Use the token to attempt to reset the password with a new password that is shorter than 8 characters while experiencing slow network conditions.
edge.expected_result: The system should display an appropriate error message indicating that the password must be at least 8 characters long.
